en: Keep matter files, research sources, instructions, review notes, and editable legal work products connected in one persistent workspace from intake through handoff.
Sort and rename approved matter folders locally, keeping source files and versions identifiable before comparison, chronology building, or handoff.
Choose models for long-context review, careful drafting, or faster preparation while preserving the same matter files, instructions, and review history.
Bring a colleague or specialist into the same matter thread while keeping questions, source files, revisions, decisions, and deliverables connected.
zh: 把案件文件、研究来源、工作要求、审阅意见和可编辑法律成果保留在同一工作空间中，从接收材料一直衔接到交付。
在本机整理并重命名核准的案件文件，让来源与版本保持可识别，再进入文档比较、时间线整理或团队交接。
按长上下文审阅、严谨起草或快速准备选择模型，同时保留案件文件、工作要求与审阅记录，不必重建背景。
让同事或专业人员进入同一案件线程，使问题、来源文件、修改意见、关键决定和最终交付物始终保持关联。

en: Keep curriculum goals, readings, school templates, lesson drafts, and revisions connected across a teaching unit, from preparation through reflection.
Talk through a lesson idea while the agent reshapes the outline, slides, activity sheet, and teacher notes in real time and preserves the editable result.
Organize course folders, handouts, reference files, and teaching evidence locally, so materials remain identifiable across classes and review cycles.
Turn lesson milestones, parent meetings, grading windows, and portfolio deadlines into prepared work blocks with the relevant materials attached.
zh: 把课程目标、参考资料、学校模板、教案初稿和修改记录放在同一单元工作空间中，从备课持续衔接到教学复盘。
边说边调整教学想法，让 Agent 实时修改教案提纲、课件、活动单和教师备注，并保留可继续编辑的成果。
在本机统一整理课程文件夹、讲义、参考资料和教学成果，让不同班级与复盘周期中的材料保持清晰可辨。
把备课节点、家长会、批改周期和职业材料截止时间转成准备充分的工作块，并提前关联对应教学材料。

en: Keep client context, interview notes, evidence, hypotheses, exhibits, review decisions, and editable deliverables connected from project intake through the final client handoff.
Think through a recommendation aloud while the project brief, option set, workshop plan, presentation structure, and next review questions develop together in real time.
Use different models for long-document synthesis, analytical challenge, drafting, and fast iteration while preserving the same client sources, instructions, and engagement context.
Coordinate consultants, specialists, and agents around one client thread, with source files, decisions, feedback, and revised deliverables returned to the group.
zh: 让客户背景、访谈记录、证据、分析假设、图表、审阅决定和可编辑交付物在整个项目周期中保持关联。
边讨论建议边修改项目简报、备选方案、工作坊计划和汇报结构，让口头判断及时沉淀为可继续编辑的内容。
在同一项目中使用适合长文档综合、分析质疑、内容起草和快速迭代的模型，同时保留客户来源、工作要求和项目背景。
围绕同一客户线程协调顾问、专业人员与 Agent，让来源文件、关键决策、反馈和修订后的交付物回到团队。

en: Keep the research question, selected sources, coding framework, evidence matrix, review notes, and synthesis connected in one traceable project.
Match models to long-context reading, comparison, structured extraction, or critical review while preserving the same source set, instructions, and evidence trail.
Normalize papers, reports, datasets, and notes locally, preserving recognizable sources and versions so the evidence trail remains navigable.
Add reusable research procedures for source collection, evidence extraction, monitoring, and document production while retaining project-specific review steps.
zh: 把研究问题、选定来源、编码框架、证据矩阵、复核记录和综合结论保留在同一个可追溯项目中。
为长上下文阅读、材料比较、结构化提取或批判性复核选择模型，同时保留同一来源集、研究要求与证据路径。
在本机统一论文、报告、数据集与笔记的命名，同时保留清晰的来源和版本信息，让证据路径持续可导航。
加入可复用的资料收集、证据提取、持续监测和文档生成流程，并为当前研究保留必要的人工复核步骤。

en: Keep the approved role brief, candidate-provided material, interview rubric, notes, communications, decisions, and editable hiring outputs connected in one workspace.
Coordinate intake meetings, interview panels, follow-ups, and candidate updates as prepared calendar work with the relevant role and candidate context.
Bring recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers, and agents into a shared thread while keeping candidate evidence, feedback, decisions, and follow-ups connected.
Organize approved candidate packets and role documents locally while preserving clear separation, recognizable naming, and an orderly handoff path.
zh: 把核准的岗位简报、候选人材料、面试标准、记录、沟通内容、关键决定和可编辑成果放在同一个招聘工作空间中。
把需求会议、面试安排、后续跟进和候选人更新组织成准备充分的日历工作，并关联对应岗位与候选人背景。
让招聘人员、用人经理、面试官和 Agent 进入共享线程，使候选人证据、面试反馈、录用决定与后续跟进保持关联。
在本机整理核准的候选人资料包与岗位文件，保持清晰的隔离、命名和交接路径，避免不同招聘项目混用。

en: Keep approved financial sources, calculations, assumptions, commentary, review notes, and editable outputs connected across recurring reporting cycles.
Select models for long filings, structured extraction, analytical challenge, or fast drafting while preserving the approved sources, assumptions, instructions, and working context.
Organize statements, exports, reports, and supporting documents locally with recognizable periods and versions before recurring analysis and review.
Prepare recurring close, reporting, monitoring, and management-review work around real deadlines, with the required inputs and expected outputs attached.
zh: 让核准的财务来源、计算过程、关键假设、分析说明、审阅意见和可编辑成果跨报告周期保持关联。
针对长篇公告、结构化提取、分析质疑或快速起草选择模型，同时保留原始来源、分析要求与工作上下文。
在本机整理报表、数据导出、分析报告与支持文件，用清晰的期间和版本命名，再进入周期分析与复核。
围绕真实截止时间准备周期结账、报告、监控和管理复盘工作，并提前关联所需输入与预期输出。

en: Keep calendar context, prior decisions, meeting material, action registers, review notes, and executive briefs connected in one continuous workspace.
Connect meetings to preparation, relevant files, follow-up, and protected work blocks instead of treating the calendar as a passive list of events.
Let leaders, assistants, teams, and agents coordinate in a shared thread while keeping source material, decisions, owners, and returned deliverables visible.
Organize recurring meeting packs, leadership updates, and working documents locally with predictable naming, clear versions, and a reliable handoff path.
zh: 把日程背景、历史决策、会议材料、行动清单、审阅记录和管理简报保留在一个持续工作空间中。
把会议连接到会前准备、相关文件、会后跟进和受保护的工作块，而不是让日历只做被动事件清单。
让管理者、助理、团队与 Agent 在共享线程中协作，同时保持来源材料、关键决定、负责人和返回成果可见。
在本机整理周期会议包、管理层更新和工作文档，保持可预测的命名、清晰版本与可靠交接路径。

en: Keep audience evidence, brand guidance, campaign briefs, channel drafts, approvals, performance results, and editable assets connected in one campaign workspace.
Talk through positioning and creative direction while the campaign brief, core messages, channel variants, and review notes develop in real time.
Choose models for audience research, strategic reasoning, rapid copy variation, image work, or long-context campaign review without rebuilding the brief.
Coordinate marketers, creators, reviewers, and agents around one campaign thread, keeping the original brief, feedback, decisions, and approved assets connected.
zh: 把受众证据、品牌规范、活动简报、渠道初稿、审批记录、效果数据和可编辑素材放在同一个营销工作空间中。
边讨论定位和创意方向，边实时修改活动简报、核心信息、渠道版本和审阅意见，让口头判断及时落到内容上。
按受众研究、策略推理、快速文案变体、图像工作或长上下文活动复盘选择模型，同时保留同一份活动简报。
让市场人员、创作者、审阅者与 Agent 围绕同一活动线程协作，使原始简报、反馈、决定和获批素材保持关联。

en: Keep client work, operating files, content plans, decisions, and editable deliverables connected, so every role continues from the same business context.
Capture a spoken update or rough idea while the working brief, next actions, and editable deliverable develop together in real time.
Turn sales follow-ups, delivery milestones, and recurring administration into prepared work blocks with the right files, context, and expected outcome.
Choose models for research, drafting, analysis, or fast execution while keeping the same source material, instructions, and business context in place.
zh: 把客户项目、运营文件、内容计划、关键决定和可编辑交付物放在一起，让不同角色都能沿用同一份业务背景继续工作。
通过语音补充进展或讲出粗略想法，让任务简报、下一步行动和可编辑交付物在同一轮沟通中实时成形。
把销售跟进、交付节点和周期行政事务变成准备充分的工作块，并提前关联所需文件、任务背景与预期成果。
在同一业务工作空间中为研究、起草、分析和快速执行选择合适模型，同时保留原始材料、工作要求与上下文。

en: Keep source material, research, drafts, brand guidance, revisions, and publishing assets connected in one creative project from idea to release.
Talk through an idea while the outline, script, article, or campaign draft develops beside you, with decisions captured in the editable work.
Switch between research, long-form writing, image work, and rapid channel adaptation while preserving the same sources, voice guidance, and project context.
Organize recordings, notes, references, drafts, and exported assets locally with predictable names, recognizable versions, and a clear publishing path.
zh: 把源素材、研究、初稿、品牌要求、修改记录与发布资产保留在同一创作项目中，让内容从构想到发布始终连贯。
边说边推进想法，让提纲、脚本、文章或活动初稿同步成形，并把关键判断直接沉淀到可编辑内容中。
在研究、长文写作、图像工作和渠道适配之间切换模型，同时保留原始素材、表达要求与项目背景。
在本机整理录音、笔记、参考资料、初稿和导出资产，用清晰的命名与版本关系连接后续发布流程。

en: Keep customer requests, operating files, quotes, updates, decisions, and editable deliverables connected across everyday business work from intake through follow-up.
Prepare recurring reviews, customer follow-ups, vendor work, and owner priorities around real deadlines, with the relevant files and expected outcomes attached.
Organize customer, vendor, finance, and operating folders locally with recognizable names and versions before the next handoff, review, or recurring task.
Coordinate owners, staff, specialists, and agents in one business thread while source files, approvals, responsibilities, and returned deliverables remain visible.
zh: 让客户请求、运营文件、报价、进展、关键决定和可编辑交付物从接收需求到后续跟进始终保持关联。
围绕真实截止时间准备周期复盘、客户跟进、供应商事务与经营者重点工作，并提前关联所需文件和预期成果。
在本机用清晰的命名和版本关系整理客户、供应商、财务与运营文件，再进入下一次交接、审阅或周期任务。
让经营者、员工、专业人员与 Agent 在同一业务线程中协作，并保持来源文件、审批、责任人与返回成果可见。

en: Keep project briefs, source files, specialist work, feedback, decisions, and editable client deliverables connected across concurrent studio projects.
Give the studio one shared thread for human and agent handoffs while keeping source files, discussion, responsibilities, approvals, and returned work connected.
Prepare client and production folders locally with consistent project, version, and delivery naming before specialist handoffs, reviews, and final release.
Reuse proven research, production, review, and delivery methods while adapting inputs, checkpoints, and final outputs for each client engagement.
zh: 让项目简报、源文件、专业分工、反馈、关键决定与可编辑的客户交付物在多个并行项目中保持关联。
让工作室在人类与 Agent 交接时使用同一共享线程，使源文件、讨论、责任、审批和返回成果始终保持关联。
在本机按照统一的项目、版本与交付规则准备客户和制作文件夹，再进入专业人员交接、审阅与最终发布。
复用已验证的研究、制作、审阅与交付方法，同时按每位客户的要求调整输入材料、检查节点与最终成果。
